messages.subject: Gradient bug
parts:
Hey,

I've been banging my head against this one for a while now and haven't
been able to track it down. I was hoping someone might be able to
take a look and see if they can find anything. The attached model and
data file produces the following with test_grad:

stan mbrubake$ ./test --data=test.data --init=0 --test_grad

TEST GRADIENT MODE

Log probability=-21.7632

param idx value model finite diff error
0 0 -9.60605e-07 -0.335553 0.335552
1 0 -2.84775e-07 -0.00651205 0.00651177
2 0 3.10635e-06 0.405057 -0.405054
3 0 8.08849e-08 -0.829704 0.829704
4 0 0 0 0
5 0 0 0 0


I've tried to simplify the model down as much as I can, but I haven't
been able to narrow further in on the issue. It's possible that this
is a numerical issue, but at the moment it seems hard to believe that
it would cause such a significant error in the gradients. In the more
complex model that this is derived from the errors are on the
magnitude of 100s or 1000s effectively point in the wrong direction.

Anyone able to take a look?

Cheers,
Marcus
